mcqs.question: Under the expanded Prime Minister Internship Scheme, which category of students was allowed by the MCA to apply for paid internships in the top 500 companies?
mcqs.explanation: The MCA allowed final-year undergraduate and postgraduate students to apply for paid internships in the top 500 companies under the expanded Prime Minister Internship Scheme. The tempting option limiting eligibility to only final-year undergraduate students is incorrect because postgraduate students were also included.
